name.baseName: Diesel, burned in building machine, without particle filter

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The average service life (10'000 h/p) and the consumption of lubricating oil are taken from ecoinvent v2.2. Fuel consumption and regulated exhaust emissions are calculated with the non-road database published by BAFU (2015) for 2015. Data from the Emissions Inventory Guidebook (EMEP/EEA, 2013) were used for specific exhaust emissions not covered by the non-road database. The emission factors are calculated for the case that only a minimal share of the building machines is equipped with a particle filter, namely when it is required by Swiss legislation. The NMVOC speciation is modelled by the shares for lorries and the noise emissions are assumed to be proportional to the fuel consumption of lorries. The fuel consumption of average lorries was calculated with the HBEFA database with data for Switzerland in 2015.; UUID: 9d237109-b8ea-3c06-9b62-9e6c7932f518

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Diesel and diesel engine

# Included processes
This dataset represents the combustion of 1 MJ Diesel fuel in an average building machine without particle filter (unless it is legally required) in Switzerland. A wide range of different building machines is included but hydraulic diggers, pumps and mobile power generators are not considered. The dataset refers to the entire transport life cycle i.e. to the production, operation, maintenance and end of life of vehicle.
